reason: A cross-platform Electron desktop application that packages and launches DeepSeek Harness with a bundled Node.js runtime and local backend, providing access to its web interface through an installed desktop app.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 打包为跨平台桌面应用，内置 Node.js 运行时并启动本地后端以提供其 Web 界面。
summaries.en: Packages DeepSeek Harness as a cross-platform desktop application with a bundled Node.js runtime and local backend for its web interface.

capabilities: Packages a cross-platform Electron desktop application
Launches a bundled local Node.js backend
Opens an embedded DeepSeek Harness web interface
Uses a user-provided DeepSeek API key
